description: This file defines an abstract base class for JSON-based grain storage providers within an Orleans application. It manages reading from and writing to a JSON-backed data store, implements cleanup, and handles serialization/deserialization of grain state objects.

classes.name: BaseJSONStorageProvider
classes.description: An abstract class implementing basic JSON storage operations for grains, including reading, writing, and clearing grain state.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the storage provider by disposing the DataManager if it exists.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads grain state from storage and deserializes it into the provided grain state object.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Serializes the grain state and writes it to storage.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Removes the grain state from storage.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes grain state into a JSON string for storage.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into the grain state object.
